entry.title: The Dead Internet Is Coming for Your Code
entry.summary: Coding models learn from public GitHub, and public GitHub is filling with untested, error-swallowing hello world apps, many written by other models. Why code quality is heading for model collapse.

entry.title: Elections, sister, aging
entry.summary: Elections come and go. I would be hard-pressed to count precisely how many elections, midterm elections, primary elections, and special elections I’ve participated in. But if I can vote in an election, I do. I’ve voted for Jessie Jackson and John McCain. One of those I’m still proud of. At heart I am a kind of centrist. I tend to seek a middle way. entry.title: Tailwind, Stack Overflow, and the Docs Snowball
entry.summary: Tailwind's docs traffic fell 40% and Stack Overflow's questions collapsed as developers asked LLMs instead. Why that loop leaves us with worse docs, shallower skills, and models that stop learning.

entry.title: Worth Wandering: The Mushroom Color Atlas
entry.summary: An extraordinary interactive collection of colors made from mushrooms, where a walk through the forest becomes an exploration of chemistry, textiles, watercolor pigments and the surprising things nature has been making all along.
